design: frozen core.corr_select optimized mixture; exact finite pi and pi_ij; same design for all target branches
sample_weight: unit weight for every training row in every branch
g: fixed D-only regularized logistic regression from the registered anchor
primary_evaluation: pre-existing E1b V_eval block, disjoint from training/Q_ref/outer T; reused development validation, not a fresh confirmation set
secondary_evaluation: outer T; no branch or alpha selection on T
cumulative_scope: single-state fork, no reconstructed multi-round CORR history
offline_hidden_residuals: exact design audit only, after all branch fits, never used by acquisition or training
continuation_gate: same predeclared shrink alpha has positive mean V_eval gain vs Observed in all 3 datasets and both seed gains positive in at least 2 datasets; FullCorrection beats Plugin in at least 2 dataset means; otherwise stop correction mainline
